background.title: Our story
background.originDesc: Whizzzest was founded by university students in Beijing who love their hometown's culture. We wanted to use modern technology to help more people discover Wanzai — a small city with a millennium of fireworks history.
background.goalDesc: Our goal is to put AI to work for Wanzai's culture and tourism: share the city's unique charm with the world, welcome more visitors to the hometown of fireworks, and support high-quality growth for the local tourism industry.

mission.title: Mission & vision
mission.missionDesc: To carry forward Wanzai's millennium-old fireworks culture so that every visitor can feel the warmth and charm of this city. We are building the most complete Wanzai travel and culture platform — making trip planning effortless and local culture easy to experience deeply.
mission.visionDesc: To become a model for digital transformation of county-level tourism and new-media operations. Working closely with local businesses and government, we want Whizzzest to be the front door through which visitors in China and abroad get to know Wanzai — and, in time, to turn this path into a blueprint other counties can follow.

tech.title: Under the hood
tech.edgeDesc: The whole site runs on Cloudflare's global edge network: static builds are served from 300+ edge locations worldwide, while merchants, the library, Whizzzest Streaming, Whizzzest Music and attractions render dynamically on Workers at the edge, with D1 and R2 close by. Even on slow connections, first paint takes about 1.5 seconds.
tech.zeroDesc: No frontend frameworks — the entire site is native HTML/CSS/JavaScript with our own zero-dependency build pipeline. Images are auto-optimized into responsive WebP variants, and AI inference (Workers AI) and email stay closed-loop on the same domain. Fast, secure, and fully under our control.

events.title: Project kickoff
events.description: The team formed, completed feasibility analysis and market research, defined the platform's positioning and strategy, and started technical preparation.

events.title: Product development
events.description: Prototype and core features built on Vue 3 + Tailwind CSS, launching the heritage and cuisine modules with a high-performance user experience.

events.title: Public launch
events.description: The platform went live to the public, with a first round of user testing and optimization, establishing the brand and its market position.

events.title: Brand building
events.description: Launched the new-media strategy with WeChat, Douyin and other channels, steadily widening the platform's reach and influence.

events.title: Rebrand & rebuild
events.description: Switched to the whizzzest.com domain and rebuilt the entire site on zero-dependency native web technology, hosted on Cloudflare's global edge — a full upgrade in speed and experience.

events.title: Merchant ecosystem
events.description: The "Whizzzest Picks" merchant system went end-to-end: listings, self-service onboarding, email-code sign-in and a paid verified-prominence loop, with merchant data managed authoritatively at the edge.

events.title: Whizzzest Streaming on air
events.description: The video channel launched with streaming uploads from the admin console and Bilibili integration — the full web series "One Encounter, Ten Thousand Years" and the city film "Meet Wanzai" are now in the library.

events.title: Library & media
events.description: The Whizzzest Library and its author portal (writer.whizzzest.com) went live with two-level review for works and chapters; the Whizzzest Music player and the attractions gallery arrived in the same wave — the content matrix was complete.

events.title: AI & interactive experiences
events.description: The site-wide AI assistant "Huanuo" launched (Workers AI + RAG knowledge base) to answer anything Wanzai; the digital fireworks simulator opened for visitors to light a Wanzai firework with their own hands.

events.title: Data-driven operations
events.description: Multi-account admin console and visitor analytics dashboards came online, connecting content review and data insight end to end; GitHub Actions now ships every iteration to production in minutes.

events.title: Media rebrand · Whizzzest Arcade launch
events.description: "Wanzai TV" became "Whizzzest Streaming" and "Wanzai Music" became "Whizzzest Music", gathered under one nav group; the browser game platform "Whizzzest Arcade" (game.whizzzest.com) launched alongside — short, finishable games with triple-backed local saves that work offline.
